formName: Step 3 - Project Information for Water Licence Application
formDescription: This step has a set of questions/fields to determine if the application is related to BC Hydro, Film production, housing, or major mines in BC.

BC Hydro_RequiredQuestionResponse.title: Are you a BC Hydro employee or agent applying on behalf of BC Hydro?
BC Hydro_RequiredQuestionResponse.description: Update here The purpose of this application must be related with BC Hydro Sustainment Project.

Film_RequiredQuestionResponse.title: Is this application related to a film or television production?
Film_RequiredQuestionResponse.description: The purpose of this application must be related with film or television production.

Housing_RequiredQuestionResponse.title: Is this application in relation to increasing the supply of housing units within British Columbia?
Housing_RequiredQuestionResponse.description: The purpose of this application must be specifically for development of houses or living units AND the development must increase the number of housing units on the land/property.

Major Mine_RequiredQuestionResponse.title: Is this application related to a major mine?
Major Mine_RequiredQuestionResponse.description: The purpose of this application must be related with a major mine in British Columbia.
